actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Microsoft Teams action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Microsoft Teams connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_channel
actions.title: Create channel
actions.help: Creates a new channel in the specified team. Standard channels are visible to all team members. Private channels restrict access to selected members.

input.name: team_id
input.label: Team
input.hint: Select a team. Only teams you are a member of are shown.

input.name: displayName
input.label: Channel name
input.hint: The name of the channel. Must be unique within the team. Maximum 50 characters.

input.name: description
input.label: Description
input.hint: An optional description for the channel.

input.name: membershipType
input.label: Channel type
input.hint: The type of channel. Defaults to Standard . Cannot be changed after creation.

actions.name: get_channel
actions.title: Get channel
actions.help: Returns details for a specific channel by team and channel ID.

input.name: team_id
input.label: Team
input.hint: Select a team. Only teams you are a member of are shown.

input.name: channel_id
input.label: Channel
input.hint: Select a channel from the list.

actions.name: get_chat
actions.title: Get chat
actions.help: Returns details for a specific chat by its ID.

input.name: chat_id
input.label: Chat ID
input.hint: The ID of the chat. You can get this from the List chats action. Alternatively, get it from the chat link by copying the part after https://teams.microsoft.com/l/chat/ .

input.name: include_members
input.label: Include members
input.hint: When enabled, the response includes the list of chat members.

actions.name: get_message
actions.title: Get message
actions.help: Returns a single message by ID from a channel or chat.

input.name: message_type
input.label: Message source
input.hint: Select whether to retrieve a channel message or a chat message .

actions.name: get_messages
actions.title: Get messages
actions.help: Retrieves messages from a channel, thread replies, or chat. Select the message source to determine which identifiers are required. Retrieves up to 50 messages per page — use the Next page link output for subsequent pages.

input.name: message_source
input.label: Message source
input.hint: Select the source of messages. Channel messages lists top-level messages in a channel. Thread replies lists replies to a specific channel message. Chat messages lists messages in a 1:1 or group chat.

actions.name: get_team
actions.title: Get team
actions.help: Returns full details for a team including member, guest, messaging, and fun settings.

input.name: team_id
input.label: Team
input.hint: Select a team. Only teams you are a member of are shown.

properties.name: showInTeamsSearchAndSuggestions
properties.label: Show in Teams search and suggestions

actions.name: get_user
actions.title: Get user
actions.help: Returns profile details for a user by their ID or user principal name (UPN).

input.name: user_id
input.label: User ID
input.hint: The user's ID (GUID) or user principal name (UPN), e.g. john@contoso.com . Enter me to get the signed-in user's profile. me is not available when using client credentials — provide an explicit user ID…

actions.name: list_channels
actions.title: List channels
actions.help: Returns channels in the specified team that the authenticated user can access.

input.name: team_id
input.label: Team
input.hint: Select a team. Only teams you are a member of are shown.

input.name: membership_type
input.label: Channel type
input.hint: Filter channels by membership type. By default, all channel types are returned (standard, private, and shared).

input.name: include_archived
input.label: Include archived channels
input.hint: Filter channels by archived status. Leave blank to return all channels.

properties.name: page_size
properties.label: Page size
properties.hint: Number of channels to return per page. Leave blank to return all channels.

properties.name: offset
properties.label: Offset
properties.hint: Copy the Offset from a previous response to fetch the next page. Leave blank to start from the beginning.

actions.name: list_chats
actions.title: List chats
actions.help: Returns chats the authenticated user participates in, including one-on-one, group, and meeting chats. Includes last message preview. Retrieves up to 50 chats per page — use the Next page link output for subsequent pages. Note: Microsoft may return fewer results per page than requested depending on t…

input.name: include_members
input.label: Include members
input.hint: When enabled, each chat includes the list of members. Note: enabling this reduces the number of results returned per page.

properties.name: page_size
properties.label: Page size
properties.hint: Maximum is 50. Use the Next page link from the response to retrieve remaining results.

properties.name: next_page_link
properties.label: Next page link
properties.hint: Copy the Next page link from a previous response and paste it here to fetch the next page. Leave blank to start from the first page.

actions.name: list_teams
actions.title: List teams
actions.help: Returns teams the authenticated user is a member of.

input.name: include_archived
input.label: Include archived teams
input.hint: When set to false, archived teams are excluded from the results. Leave blank to return all teams. Note: it may take some time for a team's archived status to be reflected by the API.

properties.name: page_size
properties.label: Page size
properties.hint: Number of teams to return per page. Leave blank to return all teams.

properties.name: offset
properties.label: Offset
properties.hint: Copy the Offset from a previous response to fetch the next page. Leave blank to start from the beginning.

actions.name: reply_to_message
actions.title: Reply to message
actions.description: Reply to message in Microsoft Teams
actions.help: Posts a reply to an existing channel message thread. Only channel messages support threaded replies. Note: This action requires Authorization code grant. Client credentials are not supported.

input.name: team_id
input.label: Team
input.hint: Select a team. Only teams you are a member of are shown.

input.name: channel_id
input.label: Channel
input.hint: Select a channel from the list.

input.name: message_id
input.label: Message ID
input.hint: The ID of the message to reply to. You can get this from the Get messages or Search messages action.

input.name: content
input.label: Message content
input.hint: The body content of the message. Supports plain text or HTML depending on the Content type field.

input.name: content_type
input.label: Content type
input.hint: The type of message body content. Use HTML for rich-text messages with formatting, mentions, or links. Use Text for plain text. Defaults to Text .

actions.name: search_messages
actions.title: Search messages
actions.help: Searches across Teams messages (channels and chats) using Microsoft Graph Search API. Returns matching messages with hit summaries. Retrieves up to 100 results per page — use the Offset output for subsequent pages. Note: This action requires Authorization code grant. Client credentials are not suppo…

input.name: query_string
input.label: Search query
input.hint: The search query string. Supports Microsoft Search KQL syntax. Example: project update .

properties.name: page_size
properties.label: Page size
properties.hint: Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 25. Maximum is 100.

properties.name: from
properties.label: Page offset
properties.hint: Copy the Page offset from a previous response and paste it here to fetch the next page. Leave blank to start from the beginning.

input.name: message_type
input.label: Message destination
input.hint: Select whether to send the message to a channel or a chat .
